facts.text: The resort is set on Dawn Beach in St. Maarten.
facts.excerpt: Situated on the captivating Dawn Beach, our luxury hotel in St. Maarten is a serene island retreat with a luxury spa, nestled amidst lush greenery and pristine white sandy beaches.

facts.text: The resort sits on the Atlantic edge of Dawn Beach, where the sand curves into turquoise water bordered by green hillsides.
facts.excerpt: Along the Atlantic edge of Dawn Beach, powder-soft sand curves into clear turquoise waters, bordered by lush green hillsides and the open horizon.

facts.text: The resort is about 30 minutes from Princess Juliana International Airport.
facts.excerpt: Just 30 minutes from Princess Juliana International Airport, the resort is set directly on Dawn Beach with open ocean views.

facts.text: Guest rooms and suites have private patios, balconies, open decks and private plunge pools.
facts.excerpt: Our guest rooms and suites feature private patios, balconies, open decks, and private plunge pools.

facts.text: Room types include beachfront rooms with a balcony and plunge pool.
facts.excerpt: 1 King, Sofa bed, Beachfront, Balcony, Plunge pool

facts.text: The Hibiscus Spa has 16 specialty treatment rooms and a relaxation area.
facts.excerpt: At our luxury St. Maarten spa resort, you can escape the ordinary with one of our 16 specialty treatment rooms and the relaxation area.

facts.text: The spa offers a steam room and separate men's and women's lounges.
facts.excerpt:
Separate Men & Women's Lounges
Steam Room

facts.text: The heated outdoor pool faces the sea and has a swim-up bar.
facts.excerpt: Cool off in our heated outdoor pool facing the sea, then glide over to the swim-up bar for a cocktail without ever leaving the water.

facts.text: The pool area has towel service and a dedicated children's area.
facts.excerpt: Guests enjoy heated water throughout the day with no set closing hours, along with towel service, a dedicated children’s area, and a swim-up bar for drinks without leaving the pool.

facts.text: Cabanas are set directly along Dawn Beach.
facts.excerpt: The experience continues across the resort, with access to the Hibiscus Spa, a 24-hour fitness center, rooftop pickleball, and cabanas set directly along Dawn Beach.

facts.text: Carambola serves seafood-led dinners beneath open-air colonnades overlooking the shoreline.
facts.excerpt: Set beneath open-air colonnades overlooking the shoreline, the restaurant welcomes guests throughout the day for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Mornings feature a continental breakfast buffet, while evenings focus on seafood-led dinner service.

facts.text: Liguria is a Mediterranean restaurant with a wine list ranging from French roses to Italian reds.
facts.excerpt: This Mediterranean St. Maarten restaurant features an abundance of fresh vegetables, seafood, citrus, grains and herbs. Complemented with a wine list ranging from French rosés to Italian reds.

facts.text: Breeze beach bar has views of the Atlantic to the east and the Caribbean Sea to the west, and delivers cocktails and bites to daybeds and cabanas.
facts.excerpt: Perfectly positioned with clear views of the Atlantic Ocean to the east and the Caribbean Sea to the west, our beachfront bar in St. Maarten serves tropical handmade cocktails and familiar bites delivered to your daybed or cabana.

facts.text: The JW Culinary School offers hands-on sessions led by chefs, with small groups limited to eight for cooking and twelve for mixology.
facts.excerpt: Using professional-grade cookware and premium equipment, guests take part in an intimate setting limited to eight participants for culinary sessions and twelve for mixology.

facts.text: Live music plays on the Lower Pool Deck three nights a week, featuring Latin, Caribbean, steel pan and French performances.
facts.excerpt: evenings take shape on the Lower Pool Deck with live music three nights a week, featuring Latin, Caribbean, steel pan, and French performances.

facts.text: Programs for children ages 3 to 12 offer hands-on activities such as arts and crafts, garden exploration and culinary classes.
facts.excerpt: have children ages 3–12 take part in programs offering hands-on activities such as arts and crafts, garden exploration, and culinary classes.

facts.text: Resort activities include sunrise yoga, water aerobics and a rooftop pickleball court.
facts.excerpt: Lay out your mat for sunrise yoga, step into the pool for water aerobics, or take to the pickleball court as the day gets moving.

facts.text: Guests can sail through the America's Cup 12 Metre Challenge or on sunset sails to nearby cays.
facts.excerpt: Sail across open waters through the America’s Cup 12 Metre Challenge or during sunset sails and excursions to nearby cays.

facts.text: The island has more than 50 dive sites, including an underwater museum of 300 reef sculptures.
facts.excerpt: Explore beneath the surface across more than 50 dive sites, including an underwater museum of 300 reef sculptures

facts.text: Ferries cross to Anguilla or St. Barths.
facts.excerpt: then ferry to Anguilla’s Greg Norman course or St. Barths for luxury boutiques and fine dining.

facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
facts.excerpt: Minimum Age to Check In: 21

facts.text: The resort describes its infinity pool as the island's largest.
facts.excerpt: Have fun with the family at our luxury St. Maarten hotel with the island's largest infinity pool
